scenes.vo: Last night, in the storeroom, one of my shadows waved at me. I didn't sleep after that.
So before my shift, I took a flashlight into the woods behind the station. Walt had to be out there SOMEWHERE.
Half a mile in, I found a clearing. An old video camera stood on a rusted tripod, pointed straight back at the gas station.
There was still a tape inside. The label said November twenty first, nineteen ninety eight. Walt's LAST night.
Back at work, I played it on the old TV in the storeroom. Walt, alone at the counter, at three A.M. And the tall thing, right behind him.
Then Walt slowly turned his head. Not toward the thing behind him. On the tape, Walt was looking at the camera. At ME.
